rule: The name has to be a picture. A player who has never opened a Monster Manual should know what they are looking at and why it is funny. D&D dictionary words stay on srd_name. Krakaren Clone is the style (a specific thing you can see and laugh at). Skeleton is not. This file does not add book-proper bosses and it does not rename Dean Thudd.

f01-m-01.picture: A cat-sized rat in the ductwork, going for ankles, and it brought friends.

f01-m-02.picture: A fist-sized mosquito with a drinking-straw nose. It drops off the ceiling, sticks to you, and sips.
f01-m-02.tagline: It files your blood under samples.

f01-m-03.picture: A small green intern. The badge is real. The job is to get hit first.

f01-m-04.picture: A person in a hoodie pressing a pamphlet into your chest. The pamphlet is not the weapon. The knife is.

f01-m-05.picture: A crab the size of a carry-on, clicking across the lobby tile like it pays rent.

f01-m-06.picture: A real mastiff wearing a mascot head it will not take off. The head is the bit. The teeth are not.

f01-m-07.picture: A person wearing a stolen staff badge, with your wallet already in the other hand.

f01-m-08.picture: A bored guard at a waist-high turnstile, flashlight in your eyes, spear not for show.

f01-m-09.picture: A department-store dummy in a staff polo. The smile is painted on. The bow is not a toy. There is nobody inside.
f01-m-09.tagline: Customer service, wrong number of bones.

f01-m-10.picture: A small green goblin with a clipboard and a club topped like a pineapple. Kill one and the rest take it personally.

f01-m-11.picture: A corpse in a janitor shirt, still pushing the mop, still biting whoever steps in the bucket.

f01-m-12.picture: A mushroom wired into the ceiling speakers. Get close and it shrieks the whole hallway awake.

f01-u-01.picture: A trainee in a neon vest holding a pole with a spearhead zip-tied to the end.

f01-u-02.picture: An ID badge on a cord that flies by itself and tries to file itself in your neck.

f01-u-03.picture: A small dog-person in a paper hat at the nacho cart. The cart is a prop. The knife is not.

f01-u-04.picture: A little cloud of hot concession steam with a face, claws, and a bad attitude about the heat lamp.

f01-u-05.picture: A junior priest chanting the hold music, holy symbol in one hand and a mace in the other.

f01-u-06.picture: A centipede as long as a mop handle, in the hallway, with a bite that makes you sick.

f01-e-01.picture: An empty pit-bull mascot costume walking around. Foam outside. Nobody inside. It still swings.

f01-e-02.picture: A huge hairy goblin-cousin who reaches you from a step farther away than your eyes agreed to.

f01-e-03.picture: A hungry corpse in the green room, eating whoever stopped moving, including the sandwich tray.

f01-e-04.picture: A see-through night-shift janitor. The mop passes through the floor. The cold does not pass through you.

f01-b-01.picture: A spider the size of a golf cart, webbing the gap between the nacho warmers.

f01-b-02.picture: A ten-foot teacher with a podium for a club. This is not Dean Thudd. The live floor still has the Dean.

f02-m-01.picture: A tall, drilled goblin in a soft-open sash. Meaner than the interns and better at standing in a line.

f02-m-02.picture: A puddle of gray mop water that climbs your boots and digests the metal while you are still wearing them.

f02-m-03.picture: A scout who already highlighted your path on a clipboard. The bow is for when the highlight is not enough.

f02-m-04.picture: A hyena-headed person with a spear. The laugh is the warning. The spear is the sentence.

f02-m-05.picture: A wolf the size of a couch, saddle worn shiny, looking for a rider or a meal.

f02-m-06.picture: A bug with long feelers that rusts the sword in your hand down to orange flakes.

f02-m-07.picture: Your own shadow, peeled off the floor, wearing nothing, hungry for the strength in your arms.

f02-m-08.picture: Goat legs, little horns, pan pipes, and a tight five about your hit points.

f02-m-09.picture: A little person made of hot coals. Touching it is the whole mistake.

f02-m-10.picture: A dust cloud with a face. It makes you cough, then it claws you for coughing.

f02-u-01.picture: A fish-person with a whistle and a trident. The pool is decorative until it is not.

f02-u-02.picture: A chicken with a lizard tail and a mean beak. One peck and you are a lawn statue.

f02-u-03.picture: A wasp the size of a motorcycle, stuffed into an usher vest, stinger first.

f02-u-04.picture: An ape at the velvet rope. The name tag says GRIP. The fists already agreed.

f02-u-05.picture: A black bear in a bow tie, checking a list you are not on.

f02-u-06.picture: A reef shark in the lobby aquarium. The glass is a suggestion it has not accepted.

f02-e-01.picture: A tiny red devil on a shoulder, wearing a producer headset, offering a deal that is already bad.

f02-e-02.picture: A wolf bigger than the couch wolf, on a security contract, with the night shift's attitude.

f02-e-03.picture: A woman with vulture wings on the marquee. Her song walks your feet off the catwalk.

f02-e-04.picture: A stone statue carved like a security camera. It sits still, then it dives.

f02-e-05.picture: A transparent cube of janitor jelly, ten feet on a side, with old mops floating in it. It moves. You do not want to be inside.

f02-b-01.picture: A big black dog. Its bark is a cone of fire down the hallway. The exit sign is not a suggestion.

f02-b-02.picture: An owl's head on a bear's body, and it is not a costume. The beak and the hug both count.

f02-b-03.picture: A knight in full plate with a sponsor logo on the breastplate and a renaissance-faire lance.

f03-m-01.picture: A pale person with no eyes, a stone club, and ears that already know where you stepped.

f03-m-02.picture: A small, soggy, awful-smelling demon. Bottom of the org chart. The smell arrives first.

f03-m-03.picture: A dog that vanishes on one side of the fence and bites you on the other.

f03-m-04.picture: A dragon the size of a cat, usually on someone's shoulder, judging your build out loud.

f03-m-05.picture: A violet fungus planted in a crop row. The stalks are whips. Do not harvest it.

f03-m-06.picture: A bird the size of an ostrich. The beak is an axe. It runs you down like you are the lawn.

f03-m-07.picture: A flying lizard with a mail satchel, dive-bombing the road like the package is you.

f03-m-08.picture: One body, two heads, both of them mad, both of them biting.

f03-m-09.picture: A tiny demon you cannot see, holding a clipboard, poisoning whatever you were about to drink.

f03-m-10.picture: A woman who is also the tree on the property line. She can step into the trunk. She does not share the yard.

f03-u-01.picture: A pirate with a cutlass who is not asking you to join. The press gang already decided.

f03-u-02.picture: A hyena as big as a pony. One animal. The laugh still sounds like a pack.

f03-u-03.picture: A lion on the green, treating the party like slow gazelles who paid for the tour.

f03-u-04.picture: A brown bear with a warden patch sewn on. The patch is not a joke. The claws are the fine.

f03-u-05.picture: Eagle in front, horse in back, wings in the middle, and it is carrying mail you did not order.

f03-u-06.picture: A toad the size of a millstone. The tongue is the first problem. The mouth is the second.

f03-e-01.picture: A huge insect that bursts out of the road under your feet and spits a line of acid.

f03-e-02.picture: A person with extra spider arms in the barn rafters, wrapping whatever used to be livestock.

f03-e-03.picture: A priest at a roadside shrine. The blessing is optional. The mace is not.

f03-e-04.picture: A big spider that steps out of sight on one side of the gate and back in behind you.

f03-e-05.picture: A lion's body, bat wings, a person's face, and a tail that throws spikes like darts.

f03-b-01.picture: One giant body, two heads, both of them charging a toll and both of them swinging.

f03-b-02.picture: A ghost in a blazer who can walk into your body and hate your application from the inside.

f03-b-03.picture: A silo full of black slime. Cut it and it splits. It eats metal, wood, and whoever brought the metal.
